roles.implement: You run as {agent}: git commit is allowed and required on your own lane branch per your brief; never push, merge or change git config.
roles.review: You run as {agent} in a review: read-only. Run tests, never edit files, commit, push or change git config.
roles.review_inline: You run as {agent} in a review with tool mode inline: you have no tools and cannot open files or execute anything; the change is quoted in this prompt. Never edit, commit, push or change git config. These rules replace every instruction below that needs a tool (opening files, tests, the skill tool): a finding is validated by a quoted diff line with its file:line; name the CI evidence the brief lists instead of test runs and say you did not run it; write FILES READ: diff only; what the diff does not show goes under Unverified and never blocks; always end with the HEAD: line and the VERDICT: line, never decline the verdict. See also the section 'Inline seats' of the review skill when it is present.
